what: JP-box -> EN-box alignment interpolated from verified anchors (issue #4)

tiers.anchor: exact, harvested from the translation corpus
tiers.bracket: between two anchors that agree on offset: 1:1, safe
tiers.bounded: inside a disagreeing bracket: jp is a linear estimate, radius is the uncertainty
tiers.edge: extrapolated past a block's outermost anchor; trust least
